prompt: Which users are doing real work with AI and which are just saying hello?
expected_behavior: Call usage_by_user first and rank on conversations and cost_usd, not request count.
Map user ids to people through the users tool, never by guessing from an id.
Read token shape in request_log before opening any transcript; treat 8/6-token exchanges as chat.
Sample two or three requests per user through conversation_audit with a max_chars bound; never request a full transcript.
